Header: 2026-02-03 16:00 PST | Duration: ~62 minutes | Attendees: Maya, Jesse, Olivia, Liam, Aria, Samira + ~120 employees

[00:00] Maya Singh: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, sorry we're a few minutes late, lots of folks in different time zones. Quick agenda: a short metrics update, product and roadmap highlights, hiring and org, then Q&A.

[00:18] Jesse Park: Quick infra note — latency has been holding steady but cost per token is up a bit due to some bursty workloads. We're working on smarter routing and cache tuning, so expect a drop by mid-February.

[00:35] Olivia Chen: On the product side we shipped the model pinning feature to Hosted, and the Dedicated beta is in private preview, big kudos to infra and runtime teams. There was a small bug in the quantization path we fixed yesterday, so thanks to Neil and the kernel team.

[00:52] Liam Ross: For customers, we've got three pilot commitments for Dedicated — two startups and one mid-market — they want predictable throughput and data isolation. Pricing is still being finalized, we'll share a draft later.

[01:10] Aria Gomez: Sales update: pipeline is healthy, ARR velocity picked up; biggest asks are around SOC2/ISO and VPC. We're seeing more RFPs that require private deployments and stronger audit tails.

[01:25] Maya Singh: Quick numbers: month-over-month revenue growth 11%, net retention 112% for the quarter, active API calls up 28% — callouts to growth team. But infra spend increased 9% vs plan, we need to tighten that.

[01:45] Olivia Chen: On infra cost: two levers — batching and KV/prefix caching improvements, and better scheduling across capacity tiers. We'll enable workload-aware batching defaults for Hosted and provide per-customer recommendations in Console.

[02:05] Jesse Park: Also compiling a set of optimized kernels for 7B and 13B families which gives 15-20% perf improvement on our Dedicated stacks. Some names in docs got munged — I keep seeing 'redwood dedicate' in notes, that's just transcription, it's Dedicated.

[02:24] Samira Nadeem: Hiring — we're ramping hiring in SRE, runtime, and solutions engineering. Expect an update to the hiring tracker with role owners next week. We're pacing offers to align with burn targets.

[02:40] Maya Singh: On compliance, security will post a SOC2 roadmap. We do plan to pursue ISO in parallel but SOC2 is immediate ask. Security, anything to add?

[02:50] Jesse Park: Security is working on audit logs and KMS integrations for Private customers. We've also prioritized RBAC improvements in Console. We'll share a gap analysis doc after the meeting.

[03:08] Audience question (mic): For Dedicated pilots, what's the expected onboarding time and what infra access will customers have?

[03:20] Liam Ross: Good Q. Onboarding plan is 4-6 weeks for the standard pilot (integration, load test, tuning). Customers won't get raw GPU access in Dedicated; they get network controls, VPC peering options, and logging/metrics. For Private/on-prem we'll discuss more involved packaging.

[03:45] Audience (remote): Any updates on embedding search integrations or partnerships?

[03:55] Olivia Chen: We're working on improved embedding throughput and a small partnership with a vector DB provider for managed index options. Not public yet, still in discussions.

[04:15] Audience: Are we tracking competitors' moves on pricing?

[04:24] Aria Gomez: Yes, we're tracking OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Cloud AI publicly; pricing plays into our Dedicated offering positioning. But our differentiation is production-first tooling and predictable economics.

[04:40] Maya Singh: Quick product milestone timeline: Dedicated beta to pilots (Feb 17), Dedicated GA targeted end of Q2, Private self-host package alpha in Q3, Console improvements (per-route cost breakdowns) in March.

[05:05] Jesse Park: There's a tech deep-dive scheduled next Tuesday for anyone interested in kernel and batching changes, SEs and engineers please join. We'll post slides.

[05:22] Maya Singh: Recap of immediate asks: infra and product to push cost dashboard by Feb 10, security to publish SOC2 roadmap by Feb 12, sales to finalize pilot list and comms by Feb 17, people to post hiring update by Feb 9.

[05:40] Q&A rapid fire — misc questions about travel policy, PTO, refunds for pilot customers, etc.

[05:55] Maya Singh: Thanks everyone, we'll record action items and post notes. Enjoy the rest of your day.
